notes.title: Regarding the Free of Charge for Touhou : Shooting Star | 東方流星譚
notes.notes:
Thank you for your interest in Touhou : Shooting Star | 東方流星譚.

Touhou : Shooting Star | 東方流星譚 has been developed by a team of four students, and due to personal reasons of the development team, we have decided to release this work for free.
To those who have purchased this work, we sincerely appreciate your support for this work. We also apologize for the sudden change to free of charge.
There will be no change in the game content, and we hope you will continue to play the game.

Tomy_Y, representative of Stardust Laboratory(星屑ラボラトリー)

notes.title: Touhou : Shooting Star 2.0 - Dive into the sky
notes.notes:
Thank you for your interest in Touhou : Shooting Star. In this update, we have made significant improvements to the graphics and changes to the system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37875642/0a5b9979ab1d126c9b3495336ba01a64f7a7e31c.png[/img]

^Additions and changes
-Improved graphics
-Replaced the background model and changed the cloud rendering system.
-Shortened the loading time of the base.

-Added status changing parameters to weapons. Weapons are now equipped with status changing parameters that affect the player's mobility.
-Discontinue giving skills to boutique accessories.
-Added vibration function to the controller (Xbox controller only. Added vibration function to the controller (Xbox controller only, can be switched in the settings)
-The tutorial for the first quest has been redesigned.

-Added the ability to take a screenshot. Added the ability to take a screenshot. Press Y or right Ctrl key on the controller during the quest to use the camera mode.
Bug fixes.
-Other minor changes

^supplement
If you feel the game is too slow, please lower the quality setting in the settings. If you feel that the game is too heavy, please lower the quality setting from the settings.
The update of "ver. 1.9", which was released as a beta version, will be implemented in the next update. This update will focus on fixes and changes, and will not add any new stages.

notes.title: Touhou : Shooting Star ver1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Touhou : Shooting Star "Version 1.3" has been released.

The additional elements and changes are as follows
New Stage "Foothills of the Monster
New Boss "Kawashiro Nitori".
Added BGM for the above two stages.
New equipment will be added as rewards for clearing the above two stages.
Added a ranking function to the Challenge Quests.
New costumes added to the boutique
Correction of radar.
Other minor modifications

Also, with the implementation of the ranking feature in version 1.3, the formula for calculating scores has been revised. Since the player's map displays the high score including previous versions, [b]The high score of the ranking function may not match the high score displayed on the player's map.
[/b]
Also, the ranking function is only available for Challenge Quests. Challenge Quests can be ordered from the rally hall.

About Challenge Quests
Challenge Quests are quests that can be ordered at the rally hall.
Enemies are more durable and have higher attack power than normal.
There are more rewards than normal quests.
There are quests that give you special rewards.
There is a maximum cost limit.
This is one of the characteristics of the game. In particular, in order to meet the maximum cost limit, the maximum rarity of the equipment must be below a certain level. Please note that if you don't meet this requirement, you will not be able to accept Challenge Quests. Equipment can be changed in the "Equipment Change Node" on the right side of the quest board in the Assembly Hall.

The new additions are :
-New Stage "Foothills of the Monster

We are looking forward to having you all play the game as we develop it.

notes.title: How to start the Hard Quest
notes.notes:
How to start the Hard Quest

Nice to meet you, I'm the developer's representative for Touhou : Shooting Star | Touhou Ryusei Tan.

If you are playing this game, thank you for purchasing it.
If not, thank you for your interest in this game.

For those of you who have played this game, you have defeated the last boss and the ending in the human village. I'm sure some of you have finished watching the event. I think there were some things in the game that were difficult to understand about how to do the game after completing the story Posted.

After defeating the last boss, a girl with a yellow balloon icon appears in the human village, as shown in the image I will. By talking to the girl, a new quest will be released. In the advanced quests, a new girl with a new yellow balloon appears as you complete the quest. So, by talking to them, you will be able to generate a quest.

We are currently aware of the problems with this system being difficult to understand, and we are looking to improve it in future updates.
